title: Wanted Drug Dealer Exposes Himself with Seatbelt Violation: Cops
description:
A 19-year-old man was arrested after a stop for a seatbelt violation allegedly uncovered a much more serious crime. Police pulled over a driver and his passenger, Jesse Tredway, after noticing the pair had no seatbelts on, according to the New Mexico State Police. The driver was later handed a simple citation while Tredway was cuffed and taken to jail. Police said the 19-year-old allegedly had an outstanding warrant for aggravated assault with a deadly weapon. But that’s not all. Tredway was also carrying a bag with him that allegedly contained trafficking amounts of various drugs. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
